Tells if the joystick of a port is still plugged in. A joystick that was removed leaves its port not connected, and plugging it in again gives it a new port.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Repeat
	Cls
	For p = 0 To JoyDeviceCount() - 1
		Text 10, 10 + p * 16, JoyDeviceName(p) + ": " + JoyDeviceConnected(p)
	Next
	Flip
Until KeyHit(1)
```
@param port  The port to ask, counted from 0.
@returns 1 if a joystick is connected to the port, otherwise 0.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
